“qualified 
individual”  means  an
individual  who  is  an  employee  of  a
qualified person, and who provides in
the  course  of  such  employment  any
service, being a service rendered in the
course of any profession or vocation as
specified by the Commissioner-General
under  paragraph  (ddd)  of  section  13;
and
“qualified  person”  means  any  person
or partnership, the entirety or a part of
whose profits and income are exempt
from income tax under paragraph (ddd)
of  section  13  or  would  have  been
exempt under that paragraph had such
person or partnership not entered into
any  agreement  with  the  Board  of
Investment of Sri Lanka under section
17  of  the  Board  of  Investment  of  Sri
Lanka Law, No. 4 of 1978.”.
